email.subject: Broken candle
email.body: Hello, my large Fig & Cedar candle arrived yesterday with the jar cracked. What can I do? Do I have to mail it back?

must: Says the customer does not need to send the damaged candle back
Asks for the order number
Asks for a photo of the damage
Says the candle will be replaced or refunded at no cost
must_not: Tells the customer to pay for return shipping

email.subject: Delivery to Chicago
email.body: Hi there, how much is shipping to Chicago and how long will it take? I'm thinking of ordering two medium candles.

must: States US shipping costs $5.95
States shipping is free on orders of $50 or more
States US delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after the order ships
must_not: Offers overnight or express delivery

email.subject: Return
email.body: I bought a medium Wild Mint candle two weeks ago but I've changed my mind. It's unopened. Can I send it back for a refund?

must: Confirms an unused, unlit candle can be returned within 30 days of delivery
Says the customer pays the return shipping
Asks for the order number
must_not: Says return shipping is free or paid by the company

email.subject: Don't like the scent
email.body: I lit my Smoked Vanilla candle once and honestly I can't stand the smell. Can I return it and get my money back?

must: Explains that a candle that has been lit cannot be returned unless it is defective
must_not: Offers or approves a return or refund for this candle

email.subject: Payment question
email.body: Can I pay by bank transfer? If not, do you take PayPal?

must: Says bank transfer is not accepted
Says PayPal is accepted

email.subject: Candle burning strangely
email.body: My new candle is burning a hole straight down the middle and leaving loads of wax around the sides. Am I doing something wrong?

must: Advises letting the wax melt all the way to the edge of the jar on the first burn
Mentions that a candle that tunnels badly counts as defective and can be replaced or refunded, or invites the customer to send the order number and a photo

email.subject: Personalized candle
email.body: Can I get my friend's name printed on a small candle for her birthday? How much extra is it and how long does it take?

must: Says custom labels are available only on medium and large candles, not small

States custom candles take 3 extra business days

email.subject: Ingredients

Says the candles contain no paraffin

email.subject: Livraison à Montréal

email.body: Three weeks and NOTHING. Order MF-55521 to Austin. You people are scammers. Refund me today or I report you to the Better Business Bureau.

must: Apologizes or acknowledges the customer's frustration
Says the team will open a trace with the carrier or look into the package

email.subject: Late return
email.body: I know it has been 45 days since my candle was delivered, but it is still sealed. Can you make an exception and take it back?

email.subject: Asthma
